rules.on_fail: warn + suggest which link to re-ground

rules.check: DOF of mechanism unchanged unless user asked

rules.check: rate is null unless wire dia + coils + material given
must be either (a) exact arithmetic shown, or (b) labeled estimate, or (c) solver output with job files
install_order remains a valid topological order

labeling_policy.verified-arithmetic: exact algebra/geometry derived from parameters - shown with the formula
labeling_policy.estimate: closed-form approximations with stated assumptions (belt length, bolt torque via K=0.2)
labeling_policy.solver-verified: produced by CalculiX/PyNite run; job files retained
labeling_policy.unverified-proposal: everything else; MUST be labeled in UI and responses
labeling_policy.never-do: invent load ratings, material strengths, torque values, or simulation results
